name: Moonlight
tagline: Stream games and other applications from another PC running Sunshine or GeForce Experience
blurb: Moonlight can stream games and other applications from another PC with Sunshine or GeForce Experience software installed.
description:
Moonlight can stream games and other applications from another PC with Sunshine or GeForce Experience software installed.

Features include:

• Hardware accelerated video decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and Vulkan Video support

• H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codec support

• 7.1 surround sound audio support

• 10-point multitouch support

• Gamepad support with force feedback for up to 16 players

• Support for both pointer capture (for games) and direct mouse control (for remote desktop)

• Support for passing system-wide keyboard shortcuts like Alt+Tab to the host

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
